metadata.dcterms:title: COLORED JONES POLYNOMIALS WITHOUT TAILS
metadata.dcterms:creator: LEE, CHRISTINE RUEY SHAN
VEEN, ROLAND VAN DER
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We exhibit an inﬁnite family of knots with the property that the ﬁrst coeﬃcient of the n-colored Jones polynomial grows linearly with n. This shows that the concept of stability and tail seen in the colored Jones polynomials of alternating knots does not generalize naively.
